description: Find the names whose DNS pointed at a value during public scans. kind ip: names that resolved to an address or into a network (CIDR up to /16 for IPv4, /32 for IPv6), plus the address's reverse-DNS names. kind mx, ns, cname or ptr: names whose records point at that host. kind spf_include: domains whose SPF includes it. kind soa: primary nameserver or contact mailbox. kind verification: a site-verification key=token TXT value. Useful for finding other domains run by the same operator. limit is 1 to 500.
name: search_reverse_dns
title: Search Reverse DNS
